200.html:
data [required]

[object]

attributes [required]

object

Attributes of a deployment gate rule evaluation.

configuration [required]

object

Evaluated rule configuration. Fields depend on rule type and unset fields are omitted. Monitor rules can include duration, query, monitor_ids, warmup, fail_on_no_groups_found, and fail_on_no_data. Faulty deployment detection rules can include duration, allowed_resources, and excluded_resources.

allowed_resources

[string]

APM resources explicitly allowed by faulty deployment detection.

duration

int64

Evaluation duration configured for this rule.

excluded_resources

[string]

APM resources excluded from faulty deployment detection.

fail_on_no_data

boolean

Whether a monitor rule fails when no data is found.

fail_on_no_groups_found

boolean

Whether a monitor rule fails when no groups are found.

monitor_ids

[string]

Monitor IDs evaluated by a monitor rule.

query

string

Monitor query used by a monitor rule.

warmup

int64

Warm-up duration in seconds for a monitor rule. Omitted when zero.

dry_run [required]

boolean

Whether this rule is non-enforcing. A failed dry-run rule is ignored when computing the gate outcome. Independent of gate_dry_run.

duration_seconds [required]

int64

Rule evaluation duration in seconds. Null while it is in progress.

env [required]

string

Evaluated environment.

evaluation_id [required]

uuid

Rule evaluation UUID. Matches the resource id.

failures [required]

object

Rule failure details.

faulty_apm_resources [required]

[string]

Names of faulty APM resources.

monitors [required]

[object]

id [required]

string

Monitor ID.

state [required]

string

Monitor state that caused the failure.

url [required]

string

URL for inspecting the monitor during the evaluation window.

narratives [required]

[object]

hostgroup [required]

string

Host group associated with the narrative.

id [required]

string

Narrative ID.

finished_at [required]

date-time

Time the rule evaluation finished. Null while it is in progress.

gate_dry_run [required]

boolean

Whether the parent gate is dry-run. A failed dry-run gate blocks but does not stop deployment. Independent of rule-level dry_run.

gate_evaluation_id [required]

uuid

Deployment gate evaluation UUID.

gate_id [required]

uuid

Configured deployment gate UUID. Null for just-in-time evaluations.

identifier [required]

string

Deployment gate identifier.

name [required]

string

Rule name.

reason [required]

string

Reason for the rule result.

rule_id [required]

uuid

Configured deployment rule UUID. Null for just-in-time rules.

service [required]

string

Evaluated service.

started_at [required]

date-time

Time the rule evaluation started.

status [required]

enum

The recorded result of a gate or rule evaluation.

  • in_progress: The evaluation is still running.
  • pass: All rules passed successfully.
  • fail: One or more rules did not pass. Allowed enum values: in_progress,pass,fail

type [required]

enum

Type of deployment gate rule. Allowed enum values: monitor,faulty_deployment_detection

version [required]

string

Evaluated deployment version. Empty when no version was provided.

id [required]

uuid

Rule evaluation UUID.

type [required]

enum

JSON:API type for a deployment gate rule evaluation. Allowed enum values: deployment_gate_rule_evaluation

default: deployment_gate_rule_evaluation

object

Pagination metadata.

page [required]

object

Cursor pagination information.

next_cursor

string

Opaque cursor for the next page. Absent on the final page.

size [required]

int64

boolean

[object]

string

request.html:
data [required]

object

Data for a deployment gate evaluation request.

attributes [required]

object

Attributes for a deployment gate evaluation request. When configuration is provided, rules are evaluated inline from that configuration. When omitted, rules are resolved from the preconfigured gate for the given service and environment.

configuration

object

Inline rule definitions for a deployment gate evaluation. When provided, rules are evaluated directly from this configuration instead of using the preconfigured gate rules. At least one rule is required.

dry_run

boolean

Gate-level dry run. When enabled, the rules are evaluated normally but the gate always returns pass. The real result is visible in the Datadog UI.

rules [required]

[ <oneOf>]

The list of rules to evaluate. At least one rule is required.

<type=monitor>

object

A monitor rule to evaluate as part of a deployment gate evaluation.

dry_run

boolean

Rule-level dry run. When enabled, the rule is evaluated normally but always returns pass. The real result is visible in the Datadog UI.

name [required]

string

Human-readable name for this rule.

options

object

Options for a monitor rule.

duration

int64

Evaluation window in seconds. Maximum 7200 (2 hours).

query [required]

string

Monitor search query.

type [required]

enum

The type identifier for a monitor rule. Allowed enum values: monitor

<type=faulty_deployment_detection>

options

object

allowed_resources

[string]

APM resource names to include in analysis. Mutually exclusive with excluded_resources.

int64

excluded_resources

[string]

APM resource names to exclude from analysis.

enum

The type identifier for a faulty deployment detection rule. Allowed enum values: faulty_deployment_detection

string

The environment of the deployment.

string

The identifier of the deployment gate. Defaults to "default".

default: default

string

A primary tag to scope APM Faulty Deployment Detection rules.

string

The service being deployed.

version

string

The version of the deployment. Required for APM Faulty Deployment Detection rules.
